scripts.dev: npm run build:metadata && concurrently -n api,worker,photos,downloader,web -c blue,green,yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sigmaos/api" "npm run dev -w @sigmaos/worker" "npm run dev -w @sigmaos/photo-worker" "npm run dev -w @sigmaos/downloader" "npm run dev -w @sigmaos/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:metadata && npm run build:rust && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run docs:build
scripts.test: cargo test --locked --workspace && vitest run && npm run docs:test
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && eslint .
